clips.title: The story
paras: The Glyphic Scroll is an official summons delivered to newly awakened Forsaken mages in Deathknell. Bearing the seal of the mage trainer Isabella, the parchment directs promising practitioners of the arcane to seek her out in the desecrated village church to hone their volatile powers.

When a freshly raised Forsaken demonstrates an affinity for arcane magic while culling mindless Scourge around Deathknell, they quickly catch the attention of their elders. Delivered by hand, the Glyphic Scroll is marked with the arcane sigil of Isabella, the local mage instructor. It bids the newly risen practitioner to report to her station within the ruined church, recognizing that unregulated magical aptitude poses as much danger to the Forsaken as it does to their enemies.

Within the ruined chapel of Deathknell, Isabella instructs fledglings that death has not exempted them from the perils of the arcane. While mortality has stripped away their physical frailties, the volatile pull and corrupting nature of magic linger just as fiercely. For the Forsaken, pursuing arcane dominance is not merely an intellectual pursuit, but an instrument of survival and vengeance—a means to reclaim their destiny and obliterate any who challenge their fragile reclamation of Lordaeron.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Ah, while you were off dealing with the mindless Scourge, this scroll arrived for you. I would think it's some matter of importance as it seems it bears the seal of the mage trainer Isabella. I would take some time to read it before heading out again.

clips.title: Progress
paras: I knew you would come to me, friend. Not because you do not have the will to follow your own path, but because we are kindred spirits. We both have felt pain. We have both suffered. And now we want the power to take back what we know is ours: this land, our lives, our destinies. But there is much for you to learn still.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You must return to me often if you are to become powerful enough to destroy those who would oppose us. The rules of magic still apply to you, friend. You will still find corruption follows you like hungry wolves in the night. You will find its caress is not unlike an addiction, an old lover still wanting to be by your side. But these things can be staved off. These things will only control you if you allow them to.
Go now, return to me when you've grown more powerful.
